vol_crop_domain — 3D domain op

• Data kinds: voxel → voxel

• Call: import volops; volops.vol_crop_domain(vol, domain=None, margin=0) (or ops3d.get("vol_crop_domain"))

Usage

Crop a volume to the tight bounding box of a domain (HALCON `crop_domain`).

• Sample-data catalog (download URLs / licences) — 2-D uses skimage.data (BSD/public domain) plus synthetic images; 3-D lists download URLs for real data sources (Stanford, PDS, …).
